Retention._comment: What this host deletes from its own database. Off by default: the rule for this sprint was measure before deciding, and the prunable count on the operations panel is what the decision is made against. Only duplicate and failed observations are ever deleted, and only once nothing links them to an incident - evidence behind a published incident is never touched. See docs/adr/023 and docs/adr/036.

Backup._comment: Copies of the database, taken with SQLite's online backup API rather than by copying a file - in write-ahead mode a file copy silently omits whatever the log still holds. There is no default destination on purpose: the only possible default is beside the original, which survives a bad write and not a failed disk. Naming a Directory is what turns this on.

Ai._comment: Mock is the default so the application runs with no credentials. Set Provider to Ollama, OpenAI, or AzureOpenAI to use a real model. Supply Ai:ApiKey through environment variables, user secrets, or a secret store - never in this file.

Providers._comment: Live OSINT adapters. Mode stays Offline so a clone of this repository makes no external calls and needs no credentials, which means it also ingests nothing: this system carries real reporting only and has no synthetic stream to fall back on. Set Mode to Live AND the individual provider's Enabled to true to activate one. Supply ApiKey/Email through environment variables or user secrets - never in this file.
